headline_marked: Anthropic unveils [[Cyber Jailbreak Severity scale]] for AI safety
headline: Anthropic unveils Cyber Jailbreak Severity scale for AI safety
summary: Anthropic publishes a framework to rate jailbreak danger, invites feedback
details: Anthropic has introduced a Cyber Jailbreak Severity (CJS) scale, a framework for rating the danger of jailbreaks in AI models. The scale ranges from CJS-0 (informational) to CJS-4 (critical).
The CJS scale scores jailbreaks on four axes and has exponential bands, with CJS-4 indicating domain-expert-level outputs that are hard to get elsewhere and require minimal effort to misuse.

Anthropic is inviting feedback on the CJS framework and has set up a HackerOne program specifically for Fable 5 cyber jailbreaks. The goal is to create a shared language for comparing the severity of jailbreaks.
caption:
Can AI safety be measured? Anthropic thinks so with its new Cyber Jailbreak Severity scale

Anthropic has introduced a Cyber Jailbreak Severity (CJS) scale, a framework for rating the danger of jailbreaks in AI models. The scale ranges from CJS-0 (informational) to CJS-4 (critical).

The CJS scale scores jailbreaks on four axes and has exponential bands, with CJS-4 indicating domain-expert-level outputs that are hard to get elsewhere and require minimal effort to misuse.

Anthropic is inviting feedback on the CJS framework and has set up a HackerOne program specifically for Fable 5 cyber jailbreaks. The goal is to create a shared language for comparing the severity of jailbreaks.

headline_marked: DEV Introduces [[New Comment Features]] to Boost User Engagement
headline: DEV Introduces New Comment Features to Boost User Engagement
summary: DEV adds features to manage comments, including hiding and permalinks.
details: The DEV platform has introduced new features to enhance user interaction with comments. Users can now hide comments, which will still be visible via the comment's permalink.
This update aims to improve the overall user experience by providing more control over comment visibility.
caption:

This update aims to improve the overall user experience by providing more control over comment visibility.
